newsitem.title: USA: Duff downgrades U S West debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff downgrades U S West debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it lowered the ratings assigned to the fixed-income securities of U S West Inc and its U S West Capital Funding Inc, U S West Financing I and U S West Financial Services affiliates.
The securities were also removed from "Rating Watch - Down", which means Duff was monitoring U S West.
The exchangeable notes of U S West, the guaranteed notes of U S West Capital Funding and the medium-term notes of U S West Financial Services have been downgraded to Triple-B-Plus from Single-A-Plus.
The subordinated liquid yield option notes of U S West have been lowered to Triple-B from Single-A.
The Trust Originated Preferred Securities of U S West Financing I have been lowered to Triple-B from Single-A-Minus.
The commercial paper rating of U S West Capital Funding has been lowered to D-Two from D-One-Plus.
The rating actions were a result of U S West's anticipated merger with Continental Cablevision, which is expected to close in the fourth quarter, the company said.
